title: China Scholarship Council PhD scholarships
about: Loughborough University offers up to 30 scholarships covering full tuition fees for China Scholarship Council-funded students starting PhD study from October 2027. Submit the PhD application by 4 January 2027; CSC has its own funding deadline.
requirements: For students receiving China Scholarship Council (CSC) funding
An unconditional offer from Loughborough University is needed before applying for the CSC scholarship
Academic and English requirements must be met by 31 January 2027
CSC sets its own separate funding deadline

upskill.name: AI for Education Academy
